reasoning: Ramsey number R(3,3)=6 implies any 2-edge-coloring of K6 (and thus K8) must contain a monochromatic triangle
cot_trace: The problem asks to find a 2-coloring of the edges of the complete graph K_8 such that there is no monochromatic red clique of size 3 and no monochromatic blue clique of size 3. Each edge is colored e...I know that the Ramsey number R(3,3) is 6, meaning any 2-coloring of the edges of K6 or larger will have a monochromatic triangle. Since K8 is larger than 6, it's impossible to have a coloring without a monochromatic triangle in either color.
